namespace = ages_of_eu
namespace = abm_focus_picks

# Ars Belli: same-name replacement of vanilla in_game/events/ages.txt (listed in replaced_files.txt).
# GENERATED by .tools/scripts/focus_picks/generate_focus_picks.js - edit focus_data.js and re-run.
#
# Vanilla ages_of_eu.1 (fired by the hardcoded on_new_age) offered one adm/dip/mil focus via
# set_age_preference. That engine slot allows a single pick, so it is dropped entirely.
# Every age from the Renaissance on has two focus slots (Economic, Military), 3 branches each.
# Players pick in the Focus Picks panel (gui/shared/abm_focus_picks_panel.gui ->
# scripted_guis/abm_focus_picks_gui.txt); AI countries pick here. A pick sets the country
# variable abm_focus_<branch>, which the branch advances use as potential.
#
# abm_focus_picks.1 is a country_event, NOT age_event: the age event window has exactly three
# cards bound to option keys adm/dip/mil and cannot show anything else.

ages_of_eu.1 = {
	type = country_event
	hidden = yes

	# Age of Traditions has no focus picks.
	trigger = {
		NOT = { current_age = age_1_traditions }
	}

	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_ai = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { current_age = age_2_renaissance NOT = { OR = { has_variable = abm_focus_court has_variable = abm_focus_trade has_variable = abm_focus_influence } } }
				random_list = {
					100 = { set_variable = abm_focus_court }
					100 = { set_variable = abm_focus_trade }
					100 = { set_variable = abm_focus_influence }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { current_age = age_2_renaissance NOT = { OR = { has_variable = abm_focus_levy has_variable = abm_focus_mercenary has_variable = abm_focus_maritime } } }
				random_list = {
					100 = { set_variable = abm_focus_levy }
					100 = { set_variable = abm_focus_mercenary }
					50 = { set_variable = abm_focus_maritime }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { current_age = age_3_discovery NOT = { OR = { has_variable = abm_focus_infrastructure has_variable = abm_focus_exploration has_variable = abm_focus_diplomatic } } }
				random_list = {
					100 = { set_variable = abm_focus_infrastructure }
					100 = { set_variable = abm_focus_exploration }
					100 = { set_variable = abm_focus_diplomatic }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { current_age = age_3_discovery NOT = { OR = { has_variable = abm_focus_quality has_variable = abm_focus_quantity has_variable = abm_focus_naval } } }
				random_list = {
					100 = { set_variable = abm_focus_quality }
					100 = { set_variable = abm_focus_quantity }
					50 = { set_variable = abm_focus_naval }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { current_age = age_4_reformation NOT = { OR = { has_variable = abm_focus_religion has_variable = abm_focus_expansion has_variable = abm_focus_humanism } } }
				random_list = {
					100 = { set_variable = abm_focus_religion }
					100 = { set_variable = abm_focus_expansion }
					100 = { set_variable = abm_focus_humanism }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { current_age = age_4_reformation NOT = { OR = { has_variable = abm_focus_offense has_variable = abm_focus_defense has_variable = abm_focus_littoral_fleet } } }
				random_list = {
					100 = { set_variable = abm_focus_offense }
					100 = { set_variable = abm_focus_defense }
					50 = { set_variable = abm_focus_littoral_fleet }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { current_age = age_5_absolutism NOT = { OR = { has_variable = abm_focus_administration has_variable = abm_focus_commerce has_variable = abm_focus_espionage } } }
				random_list = {
					100 = { set_variable = abm_focus_administration }
					100 = { set_variable = abm_focus_commerce }
					100 = { set_variable = abm_focus_espionage }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { current_age = age_5_absolutism NOT = { OR = { has_variable = abm_focus_maneuver has_variable = abm_focus_logistics has_variable = abm_focus_highseas_fleet } } }
				random_list = {
					100 = { set_variable = abm_focus_maneuver }
					100 = { set_variable = abm_focus_logistics }
					50 = { set_variable = abm_focus_highseas_fleet }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { current_age = age_6_revolutions NOT = { OR = { has_variable = abm_focus_industry has_variable = abm_focus_empire has_variable = abm_focus_innovation } } }
				random_list = {
					100 = { set_variable = abm_focus_industry }
					100 = { set_variable = abm_focus_empire }
					100 = { set_variable = abm_focus_innovation }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { current_age = age_6_revolutions NOT = { OR = { has_variable = abm_focus_voluntary_service has_variable = abm_focus_conscription has_variable = abm_focus_insurrection } } }
				random_list = {
					100 = { set_variable = abm_focus_voluntary_service }
					100 = { set_variable = abm_focus_conscription }
					100 = { set_variable = abm_focus_insurrection }
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = abm_focus_picks.1 }
		}
	}
}

# Player notice: the new age's focuses are picked in the Focus Picks panel.
abm_focus_picks.1 = {
	type = country_event

	title = ages_of_eu.1.title
	desc = abm_focus_picks.1.desc
	outcome = neutral

	illustration_tags = {
		10 = ages
	}

	option = {
		name = abm_focus_picks.1.a
	}
}
